Moderna's mRNA Flu Vaccine Approved by US FDA

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Moderna's first mRNA-based flu vaccine, mFlusiva. This vaccine is specifically designed for older adults. It utilizes the same messenger RNA (mRNA) technology that was instrumental in the development of Moderna's COVID-19 vaccines. This approval marks a significant advancement in vaccine technology, extending its application beyond COVID-19 to influenza.
